text:
No option can be put forward from this run, because the **“monthly churn rate < 4% per month”** limit could not be scored against the model.

- The price comparison itself was moderately robust under the tested assumptions, but it does not establish compliance with your churn requirement or the £20k MRR target.
- Results are also weakened by a machine default of **£0/month** for Non‑Pro MRR; no user value was recorded. Several other inputs remain provisional machine-authored assumptions.
- The model is structurally most sensitive to Active Pro subscribers, but this is a graph-based estimate rather than measured evidence.

The key reasoning step is to define the churn measure the 4% cap applies to, so it can be evaluated in a current analysis.
